summary: David Allen, Head of Long/Short Strategies at Plato Investment Management, discusses the region's market selloff as the AI slump deepens and where he sees opportunities in the technology sector. He speaks with Haidi Stroud-Watts on the sidelines of the Sohn Hearts & Minds conference in Queenstown, N

Ông nói chuyện với Haidi Stroud-Watts bên lề của hội nghị Sohn Hearts & Minds ở Queenstown, N.Y.
